commands: RUN_ID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"; echo "run-id=$RUN_ID"; mkdir -p ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1297/$RUN_ID"; echo "$RUN_ID" > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1297/current-run-id.txt; gh pr diff 1297 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1297/$RUN_ID/diff.patch" | wc -l

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .prflow_review.verdict_severity_threshold critical 2>/dev/null || scripts/config-get.sh .prflow_review.verdict_severity_threshold critical 2>/dev/null; echo "---tier checkpoint rows in workpad---"; gh issue view 1268 --json comments --jq '.comments[] | select(.body | test("prflow:workpad|devflow:workpad")) | .body' | grep -cE 'prflow:checkpoint gha:|devflow:checkpoint gha:' || echo 0

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
